next.reason: 1985: "A subsequent INITIATE statement for report-name-1 must not be executed unless an intervening TERMINATE statement has been executed"; 2023: "If it is in the active state, the EC-REPORT-ACTIVE exception condition is set to exist and the execution of the INITIATE statement has no other effect.". Both forbid re-initiating an active report. 1985 leaves a violation undefined; 2023 defines its result: EC-REPORT-ACTIVE is set and the INITIATE has no other effect.
